title: Pan-Seared Midnight Scallops with Nutty Stir Fry
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring seared scallops served with a nutty stir fry. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: stir-fry vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers and carrots

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and sugar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the seared scallops to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve the scallops with the nutty stir fry and garnish with green onions.
Cook the nori sheets according to package instructions and serve on the side.
